title: Installed printed authoring availability and saved reuse
summary: Normal installed Wright workspace; compiler/model deliberately unavailable; actual saved engineering outputs. No mocked routes or generation/process/review/action submission.

manualSteps.label: Common view
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved working-interface link, then click Use common working view.

manualSteps.label: Authoring readiness
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface and enter a description. Check the unavailable reason and disabled Create/Update controls.

manualSteps.label: Saved choice
manualSteps.instruction: Check Saved interface and Saved revision identify the existing saved interface.

manualSteps.label: Keyboard reuse
manualSteps.instruction: At compact width focus Saved interface, press Tab twice to Open saved interface, then press Enter. Check the same results return in the working tab.

steps.label: Updated installed workspace
steps.summary: The updated package opens through the normal workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify the owning workspace, not a detached UI route.
steps.actual: Normal Workflows and Files controls are available.

steps.label: Saved and common results retained
steps.summary: The saved and common views show the same outputs.
steps.purpose: Check existing evidence before opening authoring controls.
steps.expected: Exact original outputs in both views.

steps.label: Clear creation limit and usable saved interface
steps.summary: Creation is unavailable, with a visible reason; saved interfaces remain usable.
steps.purpose: Verify readiness fails before generation while saved reuse stays available.
steps.action: Open interface controls and enter a description.
controls: How should this interface help the user?
steps.expected: Visible actionable reason; Create/Update disabled and exact saved interface enabled.
steps.actual:
Reason: The qualified interface compiler is unavailable.

Configure the local qualified toolchain; existing saved interfaces and the common view still work.

Technical details. Exact saved interface and revision retained; no creation is submitted.

steps.label: Compact authoring and keyboard access
steps.summary: Authoring controls remain usable at compact width and accessible by keyboard.
steps.purpose: Check real installed control layout and scoped automated accessibility.
steps.action: Resize to480px, focus Saved interface and press Tab twice.
steps.expected: No outer overflow, zero scoped automated violations, exact keyboard focus order.
steps.actual: Document 432px/432px; zero WCAG A/AA violations; keyboard reaches exact saved revision and Open saved interface.

steps.label: Saved interface opens while creation is unavailable
steps.summary: Keyboard activation opens the exact saved interface in the same workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify real native saved reuse and unchanged engineering context.
steps.action: Press Enter on Open saved interface.
steps.expected: Exact UI/revision/run with all original outputs and no generation.
steps.actual: Exact backend binding and 20 result identities verified; no creation, process start, review or action submitted.
